No data-localisation / local-storage requirement in the PDPA

Transfer Limitation Obligation, s.26: must not transfer personal data outside Singapore unless comparable protection is ensured (conditional cross-border flow)
Comprehensive framework core obligations: Consent required (s.13) + Protection of personal data (s.24); s.14 is consent-mechanics not a core obligation
Dedicated cybersecurity framework is the Cybersecurity Act 2018 (separate instrument)
s.25 is a retention LIMITATION (must cease retention when purpose served), the opposite of a minimum-retention duty
s.11(3): organisation must designate one or more Data Protection Officers (DPO mandate); no DPIA requirement in the Act

No transfer ban or local-processing mandate; APP8 is accountability-based conditional disclosure (-> P6-I4)
No local-storage requirement
No local infrastructure / data-centre requirement

Australian Privacy Principle 8 — cross-border disclosure of personal information (accountability + comparable-protection / consent conditions); s.16C is the overseas-recipient accountability complement
Australian Privacy Principles (s.14) + APP entities must comply (s.15) — the comprehensive horizontal framework anchor
No dedicated cybersecurity framework in the Privacy Act (AU cybersecurity sits in separate instruments)
APP11.2 requires destruction/de-identification when no longer needed (a limitation); credit-reporting s.20W sets a max retention period, not a minimum-retention duty

s.33D: Commissioner may direct an agency to give a privacy impact assessment — the Act's only DPIA touchpoint (discretionary, agencies only); no general DPO mandate (agency PIA+Privacy Officer duty sits in the APP Code, not the Act); REVIEW

s.16A permitted general situations (enforcement-related activities) + APP6.2(e) permit use/disclosure to enforcement bodies without consent or a court order — government access without judicial authorisation
No transfer ban or local-processing mandate; s.129 is conditional transfer (-> P6-I4)
No data-localisation / local-storage requirement
No local infrastructure / data-centre requirement
s.129: a data user shall not transfer personal data to a place outside Malaysia unless the place is specified by the Minister or other conditions are met (conditional cross-border flow)
Personal Data Protection Principles (s.5, the seven-principle umbrella) + General Principle (s.6) — the comprehensive framework anchor
Dedicated cybersecurity framework is the Cyber Security Act 2024 (separate instrument)
s.10 Retention Principle (data shall not be kept longer than necessary) is a limitation, not a minimum-retention duty
Original PDPA 2010 imposes no DPO/DPIA requirement (DPO appointment was introduced only by the 2024 amendment, not present in this version)

s.114 search and seizure WITHOUT warrant + s.115 access to computerized data — authorized officers may access personal data without a court order (s.113, the with-warrant power, has judicial authorisation and does NOT score)
